name: NBCFDC Micro Finance Scheme
tagline: Rapid, concessional micro-credit for small trades, artisans, and self-help entrepreneurs
description: The Micro Finance Scheme is implemented through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs), Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and accredited NBFC-MFIs to provide quick credit to target group entrepreneurs with minimal documentation and subsidized interest.
objective: To finance small/petty business, artisanal activities, and retail trade for marginalized entrepreneurs living at grassroots levels.
targetGroup: Backward classes living below poverty line or with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000.
requiredDocuments: Family Income Certificate from Tehsildar/Revenue Authority
source: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC)
features: 90% financing coverage from Corporation
Direct disbursement through accredited channel partner
0.5% interest rebate for female borrowers
Flexible quarterly or monthly repayment

name: NBCFDC General Term Loan Scheme
tagline: Substantial capital financing for viable enterprise creation, expansion, and machinery
description: General Term Loan Scheme provides term credit assistance for commercially viable projects in manufacturing, processing, small transport, and service sectors up to ₹50 Lakh.
objective: To assist target group individuals in establishing robust self-employment ventures and scaling up micro-enterprises into stable small enterprises.
targetGroup: Target group entrepreneurs with annual family income up to ₹5,00,000 seeking long-term equipment/project finance.
requiredDocuments: Lease Deed or Ownership of Business Premises
features: Coverage up to 85% of total project cost
6 months moratorium on principal repayment
Tenure extending up to 7 years
Reduced rate of interest for women entrepreneurs

name: NBCFDC Concessional Education Loan Scheme
tagline: Low-interest educational finance for professional degrees in India and abroad
description: Provides highly concessional financial assistance to meritorious target-group students for pursuing approved general, professional, technical, and doctoral degree courses.
objective: To empower youth from backward classes to attain higher technical and professional qualifications without crippling debt burdens.
targetGroup: Students with annual family income up to ₹5,00,000 who have secured admission to accredited colleges or overseas institutions.
requiredDocuments: Mark sheets of qualifying examinations (10th, 12th, Graduation)
Fee structure certified by the Institution
source: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / NBCFDC
features: Special concessional rate of 4.0% for female students
Moratorium covers entire course duration + up to 12 months
Covers up to ₹15 Lakh for domestic and ₹20 Lakh for foreign studies
Repayment window up to 10 years after moratorium

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Kishore)
tagline: Mid-tier working capital & equipment loan for expanding small businesses
description: Under PMMY Kishore, loans between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 are sanctioned to non-corporate small enterprises looking to acquire inventory, equipment, or machinery.
objective: To promote micro enterprise graduation and provide collateral-free institutional credit.
targetGroup: Established micro-enterprises and service providers in urban and rural areas.
requiredDocuments: Identity and Address Proof of Proprietor/Partners
Quotation of Machinery / Goods to be purchased
features: No collateral or third-party guarantee required
Covered under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU)
Available across all commercial and rural banks
Mudra Card provided for flexible working capital withdrawals

name: NSKFDC Green Business & Sanitation Equipment Scheme
tagline: Financial assistance for eco-friendly businesses and mechanized sanitation equipment
description: Supports Safai Karamcharis and sanitation workers to adopt green business activities, solar installation, battery-operated e-rickshaws, and mechanized desludging machines.
objective: Dignified livelihoods and elimination of manual scavenging through modern mechanized machinery.
targetGroup: Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, sanitation workers, and their identified dependents.
source: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
features: Subsidized interest rate starting from 5%
Promotes zero manual hazard and automated sanitation
Capital subsidy integration available where notified
Training & technical support through channel partner

name: Stand-Up India Greenfield Scheme
tagline: Promoting entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities for new ventures
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
objective: To support indigenous and female entrepreneurship in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sectors.
targetGroup: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs aged above 18 years setting up their first enterprise.
source: Stand-Up India / SIDBI / Ministry of Finance
features: Composite loan covering term loan and working capital
Extended moratorium up to 18 months
Dedicated handholding support via Lead District Managers
Guaranteed under Credit Guarantee Scheme for Stand Up India (CGSUI)
